notices.title: Planning Commission Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

CITY OF SARATOGA SPRINGS

Thursday, September 24, 2026 @ 6:00 pm
City of Saratoga Springs Council Chambers
319 S. Saratoga Road, Saratoga Springs, UT 84045

CALL TO ORDER

1.	Pledge of Allegiance.
2.	Roll Call
3.	Public Input - This time has been set aside for the public to express ideas, concerns, and comments for subject matter not listed as public hearing on the agenda. Please avoid repetitive comments. Limit of 3 minutes per speaker, unused time may not be given to another. Time for Public Input is limited to no more than 15 minutes total.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

	The Commission will accept public comment and may make a recommendation to the City Council for the following items:

1.	Annexation Policy Plan Update Public Hearing, located approximately in the Andover Annexation area northeast of Pony Express Parkway and Clark Drive. Planner II Sam Stout. 
2.	Spring Heights II Rezone, General Plan Amendment (GPA), located at 2300 N. Redwood Road. Marty Beaumont with St. John Properties as applicant. Senior Planner Austin Roy.
3.	Saratoga Springs Senior Seminary Rezone, and General Plan Amendment (GPA), located Northwest of New Alpine School District High School. Bradley Gygi as applicant. Senior Planner David Jellen and Planner II Caden Baines.
4.	Amendment to Title 19 Land Development Code of the City of Saratoga Springs, Chapter 19.05 - Supplementary Regulations - Fencing for Public Utilities, located at West Village Parkway Parcel 59:011:0083. Corey Pace as applicant. Senior Planner Kendal Black.

BUSINESS ITEMS

The Commission will discuss (without public comment) and may either make a recommendation to the City Council, or approve the following items as needed:

1.	RMP Jumbers Substation Site Plan, located at West Village Parkway Parcel 59:011:0083. Corey Pace as applicant. Senior Planner Kendal Black.
2.	Saratoga Springs Commercial Plat F Lot 606 Site Plan, located at 1199 North Redwood Road. Thomas Lehnardt as applicant. Senior Planner Kendal Black.
3.	Saratoga Springs Commercial Plat G Lot 712 Site Plan, located at 421 West Lake Drive. Thomas Lehnardt. Senior Planner Kendal Black.
4.	Evans Estates Preliminary Plat, located at 1126 West Fairfield Road. Daryl Hodgson as applicant. Senior Planner Austin Roy.
5.	Approval of Minutes: August 27, 2026.

REPORTS

1.	Commissioner's Comments.
2.	Director's Report.

CLOSED SESSION

	Possible motion to enter into closed session for the purchase, exchange, or lease of property; pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or the physical or mental health of an individual; or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems.

ADJOURNMENT

notices.title: Public Hearings for Planning Commission Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

Notice of Public Hearing

Notice is hereby given that The City of Saratoga Springs Planning Commission will conduct a public hearing during their regular meeting beginning at 6:00 p.m. on September 24, 2026 in the City Council Chambers, 319 S. Saratoga Road, Saratoga Springs UT 84045, on the following:

1.	Saratoga Springs Senior Seminary General Plan Amendment and Rezone, located approximately northwest of the new Alpine School District High School. The proposed General Plan Amendment would change the designation on the Future Land Use Map from Low Density Residential to Institutional/Civic. The proposed Zoning Map Amendment would rezone the property from Planned Community (PC) to Institutional/Civic (I/C) to allow the seminary as a permitted use. Bradley Gygi as applicant. 
2.	Amendment to Title 19 Land Development Code of the City of Saratoga Springs, Chapter 19.05 - Supplementary Regulations.  Located at West Village Parkway Parcel 59:011:0083. The proposed amendment would provide an exception to allow a 10-foot wall or fence for public utilities. Corey Pace as applicant.
3.	Spring Heights II Rezone from Agricultural (A) to Light Industrial (LI)/ Regional Commercial (RC), General Plan Amendment from Business Park (BP) to Light Industrial (LI)/ Regional Commercial (RC), and Development Agreement. Located at 2300 North Redwood Road. Marty Beaumont with St. John Properties as applicant

Comments & questions may be directed to the Community Development Dept. 801-766-9793 ext. 155. Comments may also be submitted to comments@saratogasprings-ut.gov.

notices.title: Public Hearings for Planning Commission
notices.agenda_text:
Notice of Public Hearing for Planning Commission

Notice is hereby given that The City of Saratoga Springs Planning Commission will conduct a public hearing during their regular meeting beginning at 6:00 p.m. on August 27, 2026 in the City Council Chambers, 319 S. Saratoga Road, Saratoga Springs UT 84045, on the following:

1.	Andover Rezone from Agricultural to R1-9 (Residential Single Family, 9,000), located at approximately northeast of Clark Drive and Pony Express Parkway. Scott Carson as applicant.
2.	Amendment to Title 19 Land Development Code of the City of Saratoga Springs, Chapter 19.20 - Internal Accessory Dwelling Units (IADUs). The proposed amendment establishes regulations for detached accessory dwelling units (DADUs), in accordance with recent changes to Utah State Code. Citywide. City-Initiated.
3.	Amendment to Title 18, Building and Construction Code, Chapter 18.02 - Flood Damage Prevention. The proposed amendment would update the City's floodplain development requirements, including increasing the required elevation of structures above the floodplain and providing a permitting process and flowchart for projects involving Letters of Map Revision (LOMR) and hydraulic analyses. Citywide. City-Initiated.

Comments & questions may be directed to the Community Development Dept. 801-766-9793 ext. 155. Comments may also be submitted to comments@saratogasprings-ut.gov.
